description: List of Bridges & Culverts on Highland Highways is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Depa Kutao, Mirzi Betasolo (Papua New Guinea University of Technology). This data records the locations of Bridges and culverts along the highland highways of Papua New Guinea, which totals 95 locations. Coverage: national (PG); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
